title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Caribbean Crush Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Caribbean Crush Nic Salt fuses tropical Pineapple and Mango with a splash of Citrus for a vibrant, sun-drenched flavour. The Pineapple brings a tart, juicy bite, while Mango offers smooth, mellow sweetness. Zesty citrus undertones tie it all together, adding a light tang that brightens the finish. It’s a flavour with laid-back island vibes—ideal for fans of tropical fruit blends that feel bright and breezy from start to finish. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is made for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits and pod systems. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for quick nicotine satisfaction and a smooth draw. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
